dedupe_keys.name: shadow index of the city of luxembourg

description: FAIRiCUBE deposits a shadow-index map for Luxembourg City as one public 10-metre Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF under CC BY 4.0. The provider says the index quantifies the extent of shaded areas, and the file name contains 2019. A city heat or outdoor-comfort simulation could use such a layer to distinguish exposed and sheltered streets and public space. The landing page does not define the index range, calculation time, source buildings and vegetation, sun angle or validation. A single shadow score cannot by itself represent shade at every hour or season. The 2019 filename should not be read as proof of measurement during that year. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Luxembourg City layer. Its TIFF was not downloaded, so pixel meaning, projection and nodata treatment remain unchecked. Model users need the missing method details before treating values as physical irradiance.
